question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Peril
solution:
The correct answer is "**Hazard**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Peril" means danger or risk.**(जोखिम)

 
 
• Example: He faced great peril while hiking in the mountains
 
 
 
• **"Hazard" is a synonym of "peril", it means a danger or risk.** (ख़तरा या जोख़िम)
 
 
• Example: Smoking is a serious health hazard.
 
 
 
• Other synonyms of "peril" include "threat", "jeopardy", and "endangerment".
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "hazard" is the synonym of the word "peril."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Process", means a series of actions or steps taken to achieve a particular goal.(प्रक्रिया)
 
• Option 2, "Permission", means the act of allowing someone to do something or giving them the authority to do it.(अनुमति)
 
• Option 3, "Petal", refers to one of the small, often colored parts of a flower that are arranged together to form the flower's bloom.(पत्ती)
